notes.title: Painting mechanic and bug fixes
notes.content:
Hello, Builders!
In this update, we've fixed several bugs, improved some systems, and added a new mechanic!

Fixed Bugs:

 Fixed a bug where the character's hands would disappear in certain poses.
 Fixed a bug where tools could be grabbed from a distance.

Сhanged mechanics:

 Reworked the inventory system.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075098/ab8f7501cd0b417b13aa7c4292179d918a63d88b.jpg
 Trees now yield more logs.
 Reworked a system that caused the chainsaw to deal inconsistent and unreliable damage to wood.

New mechanic

You can now paint your buildings!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075098/76f45eae9306611339b472f9c6bfcfb98b5c21c1.jpg

We hope these changes bring some enjoyable variety to your building experience. Good luck out there - and stay safe on the construction site!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest starts tomorrow! Forest Construction VR is waiting for you!🌲🔨
notes.content:
Steam Next Fest starts tomorrow, and our game 
Forest Construction VR will take part in it!

If you've ever wanted to try building with your own hands in VR — now’s the perfect time to dive in!

What awaits you:

 Freeform construction using planks, logs, and more
 Realistic physics and hands-on tools
 A peaceful forest world with immersive natural sounds
 Endless room for creativity and experimentation

The demo is already available and will stay up even after the festival — so you can enjoy it anytime!

Add the game to your wishlist to stay in the loop on upcoming features and announcements!

Thank you for being with us. Build, create, relax.
- Forest Construction VR Team

notes.title: Demo 2.0 is now available!
notes.content:
Hello, Builders!
We’re excited to introduce Demo Version 2.0, packed with improvements and new features.

What’s New in Demo Version 2.0

Expanded and Enhanced Location
The world is now significantly larger! We've expanded the playable area and reworked the vegetation and environment — making everything feel more vibrant and alive.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075098/f864a49a3f8f217f80db91622b94771a37428351.jpg
New Building Material
A new type of construction material has been added:

Clay

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075098/213fdbaa2c72f6e5df0348ad1285037868f938c2.jpg
Updated Tools and New Tools
We've improved existing tools and added new ones:

 Scythe – for easily cutting grass.
 Chainsaw – makes harvesting wood effortless.
 Jackhammer – quickly breaks stone and extracts clay.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075098/0c144cc986334611799f72a481c4223cd0ce0b72.jpg
New Crafting Recipes
We’ve added new crafting recipes to expand your building possibilities.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075098/7fa9a932d73444b363e451b4c402870bb31b593f.jpg
Transportation Upgrades
The existing vehicle has been upgraded — it’s now more reliable and easier to handle.
We’ve also added a new type of transport, designed specifically for moving construction materials and equipment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075098/9f8cb2ec06aaf69af0273e180f618a92829f83a9.jpg
Physical Player Body & Movement Improvements
We've added a physical body to the player character, along with the ability to jump and climb, making movement feel more natural and immersive.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075098/a99bde5c912f86091de3e318e5b75ead4d0d026b.jpg
We hope you enjoy the new features and have a great time exploring the updated world!

notes.title: Announcement of big changes in the game!
notes.content:
Hello, Builders!
Initially, we planned to update the main game’s Steam page with new screenshots and visual improvements.
However, our plans have changed — all our efforts are now focused on preparing the demo version for participation in the Steam Next Fest.

What does this mean for you?
We're working on a major update to the demo, which will be released within a month. This is not just a patch — it’s a brand-new stage in the game’s development! Here's what to expect:

 New content and materials
 New tools
 A fully-featured player body
 A full physical character: running, jumping, crouching, grabbing objects
 Updated forest visuals
 A couple of new crafting options to enrich the gameplay

notes.title: Developer Diary #1
notes.content:
Hello, Builders!
We are excited to announce that we are actively working on the full version of Forest Construction VR and are ready to share key updates.

Leaving Early Access
The game is no longer in early access! The full version will include all planned content, and we will continue releasing updates to improve its quality and scale.

A New, Large Location Divided into Biomes
The game now features five distinct biomes:

 Winter Biome – Snow-covered landscapes and a cold climate.
 Autumn Biome – Golden leaves and crisp air.
 Spring Biome – Awakening nature and fresh greenery.
 Dead Forest Biome – A desolate and dry place.
 Birch Grove Biome – Cozy and picturesque scenery.

Environment
Compared to the demo version, the world has become much more vibrant and diverse:
More trees, bushes, rocks, and natural objects.

Building Materials
Greater Variety of Building Materials:
Four types of logs from different tree species instead of just one.

Crafting System
We are working on a crafting system that will expand construction possibilities and introduce new customization options for buildings.

And finally
Updated screenshots showcasing the final visuals of the full version will be available on the Steam page soon!

Thank you for following our development!
